title: GameLiveVideo
responsibility: Attach an explicitly supplied remote video stream to its preview and clear it when replaced.

inputs.name: GameLiveVideo.stream
inputs.description: Optional MediaStream assigned to the video element's srcObject; when omitted, the component assigns null. FPS is measured only from requestVideoFrameCallback callbacks, so the status stays “waiting for video frames” until those callbacks arrive.

outputs.name: GameLiveVideo
outputs.description: Markup renders an autoplaying, muted, inline video labeled “AI video” plus a status line that shows “waiting for video frames” or the measured FPS. FPS is rounded from video-frame callbacks over intervals of at least one second; when the video element supports callbacks and a stream is set, the effect attaches it and clears srcObject during cleanup.
